pages.text: From Villager Recruits level 8, each new level rolls for a $(l)legendary perk$(): 12%, plus 3% for every miss, and a guaranteed perk by level 14. A $(l)second slot$() opens at level 14 and fills by level 21 at the latest. Results are saved; screens never reroll them.

17 perks, strong but fair (no invulnerability or resurrection), for example:$(li)$(l)Vanguard$(): fights better beside 2+ comrades$(li)$(l)Tactician$(): special skills recharge 25% faster$(li)$(l)Giantslayer$(): +8% against big foes$(li)$(l)Unbroken$(): slowly recovers when badly hurt$(li)$(l)Warden$(): tougher near you
